name: iam:PassRole + lambda:CreateFunction + lambda:CreateEventSourceMapping
description: Create a Lambda function with a privileged role and configure it to be triggered by a DynamoDB stream event source, executing code with elevated privileges without manual invocation
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role ARN must be in the Resource section
Must have permission to create Lambda functions
Must have permission to create event source mappings

additional.description: Helpful for discovering available roles to pass
Useful for viewing role trust policies and attached permissions
Get table details including stream ARN
Trigger Lambda execution by inserting record into DynamoDB table
Useful for seeing existing event source mappings

admin: A role must exist that trusts lambda.amazonaws.com to assume it
The role must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
An event source must exist (DynamoDB stream, Kinesis stream, or SQS queue)
lateral: A role must exist that trusts lambda.amazonaws.com to assume it
An event source must exist (DynamoDB stream, Kinesis stream, or SQS queue)

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to Lambda

options.name: EVENT_SOURCE_ARN
options.description: DynamoDB stream ARN to use as event source

options.name: TABLE_NAME
options.description: DynamoDB table name for inserting trigger records

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Clean up Lambda function and ESM after execution (starting user may lack DeleteFunction permission)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an existing IAM user or role

payloads.name: backdoor/create-access-key
payloads.description: Create new access keys for an existing IAM user (does not work on roles)

payloads.name: backdoor/create-role
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with administrator privileges and a custom trust policy

payloads.name: backdoor/create-user
payloads.description: Create an IAM user with administrator privileges and console access

payloads.name: backdoor/update-role-trust
payloads.description: Update a role's trust policy to add a trusted principal

payloads.name: exfil/https
payloads.description: Send extracted credentials to a remote HTTPS endpoint

payloads.name: exfil/response
payloads.description: Extract credentials and return them in the Lambda function response

payloads.name: exfil/s3
payloads.description: Exfiltrate Lambda execution role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket

payloads.name: revshell/tls
payloads.description: Establish a TLS-encrypted reverse shell from inside a Lambda function. Only works with new-passrole modules where the function timeout can be set to 900s
